entries.sanskrit:
त्रयो-विंशे ततो योग- निर्मिते सर्व-संपदि ।

विमाने कामगे चित्रातयो रतिर् उदीर्यते ॥

प्रस्थिते गमने कृते सति ॥१-२॥
word_for_word: त्रयो-विंशे ततो योग- निर्मिते सर्व-संपदि
In the twenty-third chapter, then,
विमाने कामगे चित्रातयो रतिर् उदीर्यते
enjoyment in the wondrous, wish-moving aerial palace created by yoga and endowed with every prosperity is described,
प्रस्थिते गमने कृते सति
once departure and travel had taken place.
entries.literal_english: In the twenty-third chapter, then, enjoyment in the wondrous, wish-moving aerial palace created by yoga and endowed with every prosperity is described, once departure and travel had taken place.

entries.sanskrit: सुहृत् प्रियः । मद्-अर्थे क्षपयितुं नावेक्षितो न गणितः । समुचितः श्लाघ्योऽपि मत्-सेवासक्तयोपेक्षित इत्य् अर्थः ॥६॥
word_for_word: सुहृत् प्रियः
“Suhṛt” means beloved.
मद्-अर्थे क्षपयितुं नावेक्षितो न गणितः
She was not considered or reckoned as something to be expended for my sake.
समुचितः श्लाघ्योऽपि मत्-सेवासक्तयोपेक्षित इत्य् अर्थः
Although suitable and praiseworthy, she was neglected because she was devoted to serving me.

entries.sanskrit:
तपश् च समाधिश् च विद्या च उपासना तासु य आत्म-योगश् चित्तैकाग्र्यं, तेन विजिताः प्राप्ता भगवत्-प्रसादा दिव्य-भोगाः, तान् एव तेऽवरुद्धांस् त्वयापि वशी-कृतान् प्रपश्य । ते दिव्यां दृष्टिं वितरामि, यथा दृष्ट्या द्रक्ष्यसि ॥७॥

अन्ये पुनर् भोगाः किम् ? न किम् अपि । अतितुच्छा इत्य् अर्थः । तत्र हेतुः---भगवत उरुक्रमस्य या भ्रूः, तस्या उद्विजृम्भो वक्री-भावः, तेन विभ्रंशिता अर्थ-रचना मनो-रथा येषु । निज-धर्मेण पाति-व्रत्येन दुह्यन्त इति तथा तान् । दुरधिग्आन् दुष्प्रापान् । नृपा वयम् इति या विक्रियास् तत्-तद्-भोग-विकृतयस् ताभिः ॥८॥
word_for_word: तपश् च समाधिश् च विद्या च उपासना तासु य आत्म-योगश् चित्तैकाग्र्यं, तेन विजिताः प्राप्ता भगवत्-प्रसादा दिव्य-भोगाः, तान् एव तेऽवरुद्धांस् त्वयापि वशी-कृतान् प्रपश्य

Austerity, concentration, knowledge, and worship; among these, “self-yoga” means one-pointedness of mind; through them divine enjoyments are attained by the Lord’s grace, so behold those very enjoyments, mastered by you.
ते दिव्यां दृष्टिं वितरामि, यथा दृष्ट्या द्रक्ष्यसि
I grant you divine sight, by which you will see.
अन्ये पुनर् भोगाः किम् ? न किम् अपि
“What of other enjoyments?” “Nothing at all.”
अतितुच्छा इत्य् अर्थः
That is, they are exceedingly insignificant.
तत्र हेतुः---भगवत उरुक्रमस्य या भ्रूः, तस्या उद्विजृम्भो वक्री-भावः, तेन विभ्रंशिता अर्थ-रचना मनो-रथा येषु
The reason is this: the eyebrow of the Lord Urukrama, by its expansion or curve, shatters the plans and desires of those seeking material aims.
निज-धर्मेण पाति-व्रत्येन दुह्यन्त इति तथा तान्
They are consumed by their own dharma, their chastity.
दुरधिग्आन् दुष्प्रापान्
“Hard to attain” means difficult to obtain.
नृपा वयम् इति या विक्रियास् तत्-तद्-भोग-विकृतयस् ताभिः
Their changes as kings are transformations produced by each respective enjoyment.
entries.literal_english: Austerity, concentration, knowledge, and worship; among these, “self-yoga” means one-pointedness of mind; through them divine enjoyments are attained by the Lord’s grace, so behold those very enjoyments, mastered by you. I grant you divine sight, by which you will see. “What of other enjoyments?” “Nothing at all.” That is, they are exceedingly insignificant. The reason is this: the eyebrow of the Lord Urukrama, by its expansion or curve, shatters the plans and desires of those seeking material aims. They are consumed by their own dharma, their chastity. “Hard to attain” means difficult to obtain. Their changes as kings are transformations produced by each respective enjoyment.

entries.sanskrit: अखिला योग-मायाश् च विद्याश् च तत्-तद्-उपासनाः, तासु विचक्षणं निपुणम् एवं ब्रुवाणं पतिम् अवेक्ष्य गताधिर् निश्चिन्ता जाता । संप्रश्रयो विनयः प्रणयः प्रेम ताभ्यां विह्वला गद्-गदा तया गिरा ईषद्-व्रीडा-सहितो योऽवलोकः, तेन विलसद् विकसितं हसितं जात-हासं चाननं यस्याः सा । आह जगाद ॥९॥
word_for_word: अखिला योग-मायाश् च विद्याश् च तत्-तद्-उपासनाः, तासु विचक्षणं निपुणम् एवं ब्रुवाणं पतिम् अवेक्ष्य गताधिर् निश्चिन्ता जाता
All the yogic powers and sciences, and the practices associated with each of them,
संप्रश्रयो विनयः प्रणयः प्रेम ताभ्यां विह्वला गद्-गदा तया गिरा ईषद्-व्रीडा-सहितो योऽवलोकः, तेन विलसद् विकसितं हसितं जात-हासं चाननं यस्याः सा
her anxiety left her and she became free of worry on seeing her husband, proficient in all of them, speaking in this way.
आह जगाद
Overwhelmed by humility and love, her voice faltered; with a glance slightly touched by bashfulness, her face shone with a blossoming smile; she spoke.

entries.sanskrit: बतेति हर्षे । द्विज-वृष ! द्विज-श्रेष्ठ ! हे भर्तः ! त्वय्य् एतत् सर्वं राद्धं सिद्धम् एव । तद् अहम् अवैमि जानामि । किन्तु यस् ते त्वया समयोऽभिहितः स तावद् भूयात् । सकृद् इति गर्भ-संभव-मात्र-पर्यन्त इत्य् अर्थः । यस्माद् गरीयसि श्रेष्ठे भर्तरि हेतु-भूते स्त्रीणां प्रसवो गुणो महान् लाभः । समास-पाठे गरीयसि पत्यौ सति सतीनां यतो गुण-प्रसवो गुण-विस्तारो भवति । अतः पुत्रोत्पत्त्या मम गुण-विस्तारे जाते पश्चात् त्वद्-उक्तं सर्वं भवत्व् इति भावः ॥१०॥
word_for_word: बतेति हर्षे
“Bata” expresses joy.
द्विज-वृष ! द्विज-श्रेष्ठ ! हे भर्तः ! त्वय्य् एतत् सर्वं राद्धं सिद्धम् एव
“Dvija-vṛṣa” means “O best of brāhmaṇas”; “O husband!”
तद् अहम् अवैमि जानामि
“All this has indeed been accomplished by you.”
किन्तु यस् ते त्वया समयोऽभिहितः स तावद् भूयात्
“I know this.”
सकृद् इति गर्भ-संभव-मात्र-पर्यन्त इत्य् अर्थः
“But may the agreement you made with me be fulfilled.”
यस्माद् गरीयसि श्रेष्ठे भर्तरि हेतु-भूते स्त्रीणां प्रसवो गुणो महान् लाभः
“Once” means only until conception has taken place.
समास-पाठे गरीयसि पत्यौ सति सतीनां यतो गुण-प्रसवो गुण-विस्तारो भवति
Because, when the husband is excellent, childbirth is a great benefit and virtue for women.
अतः पुत्रोत्पत्त्या मम गुण-विस्तारे जाते पश्चात् त्वद्-उक्तं सर्वं भवत्व् इति भावः

Or, in the compound reading, when an excellent husband is present, the virtues of chaste women expand; therefore, once my virtues have been increased by the birth of a son, let everything you said afterward come to pass.
entries.literal_english: “Bata” expresses joy. “Dvija-vṛṣa” means “O best of brāhmaṇas”; “O husband!” “All this has indeed been accomplished by you.” “I know this.” “But may the agreement you made with me be fulfilled.” “Once” means only until conception has taken place. Because, when the husband is excellent, childbirth is a great benefit and virtue for women. Or, in the compound reading, when an excellent husband is present, the virtues of chaste women expand; therefore, once my virtues have been increased by the birth of a son, let everything you said afterward come to pass.

entries.sanskrit: अङ्ग-सङ्गार्थं च प्रथमम् इति कर्तव्यतां संपादयेत्य् आह---हे ईश, तत्र अङ्ग-सङ्गे इति कृत्यं साधनं यथोपदेशं काम-शास्त्रानुसारेण उपशिक्ष सञ्जानीही, उपकल्पयेत्य् अर्थः । येन साधनेन अभ्यङ्ग-भोजन-पानादिनातीव रन्तुम् इच्छया कर्शितो दीनश् च ममैष आत्मा देहः सिद्ध्येत रति-समर्थो भवेत् । कथं-भूतायाः ? ते त्वयैव कृतः क्षोभितो यो मनो-भवः, तेन धर्षितायाः । तत् ततोऽनुरूपं भवनं विचक्ष्व वितर्कय, विचारयेति यावत् ॥११॥
word_for_word: अङ्ग-सङ्गार्थं च प्रथमम् इति कर्तव्यतां संपादयेत्य् आह---हे ईश, तत्र अङ्ग-सङ्गे इति कृत्यं साधनं यथोपदेशं काम-शास्त्रानुसारेण उपशिक्ष सञ्जानीही, उपकल्पयेत्य् अर्थः
First he says that the arrangements for bodily union must be made.
येन साधनेन अभ्यङ्ग-भोजन-पानादिनातीव रन्तुम् इच्छया कर्शितो दीनश् च ममैष आत्मा देहः सिद्ध्येत रति-समर्थो भवेत्
“O Lord, teach me and explain what should be done for union, the means, according to instruction and in keeping with the treatise on love; that is, prepare it.”
कथं-भूतायाः ? ते त्वयैव कृतः क्षोभितो यो मनो-भवः, तेन धर्षितायाः
By those means—massage, food, drink, and the like—may this body of mine, emaciated and weak from intense longing for pleasure, become fit for union.
तत् ततोऽनुरूपं भवनं विचक्ष्व वितर्कय, विचारयेति यावत्
“Of what sort am I?” I am tormented by the desire for love that you yourself aroused; therefore consider and decide upon a suitable dwelling.
entries.literal_english: First he says that the arrangements for bodily union must be made. “O Lord, teach me and explain what should be done for union, the means, according to instruction and in keeping with the treatise on love; that is, prepare it.” By those means—massage, food, drink, and the like—may this body of mine, emaciated and weak from intense longing for pleasure, become fit for union. “Of what sort am I?” I am tormented by the desire for love that you yourself aroused; therefore consider and decide upon a suitable dwelling.

entries.sanskrit: तुभ्यं तव कर्म-करीः परिचारिका वयम् अस्मान् आज्ञापयेति स्त्रियः प्रोचुः ॥२७॥
word_for_word: तुभ्यं तव कर्म-करीः परिचारिका वयम् अस्मान् आज्ञापयेति स्त्रियः प्रोचुः
The women said, “We are your servants and attendants; please give us your orders.”
entries.literal_english: The women said, “We are your servants and attendants; please give us your orders.”

entries.sanskrit: ततश् च स्नानेन स्नान-योग्य-तैलादिना ॥२८॥ परर्ध्यान्य् उत्कृष्टानि । वरीयांसि तत्-प्रियाणि द्युमन्ति दीप्तिमन्ति च । पानं पेयम् । अमृतं स्वादु । आसवं मादकम् ॥२९॥
word_for_word: ततश् च स्नानेन स्नान-योग्य-तैलादिना
Then, by bathing and by oils suitable for bathing, and the like.
परर्ध्यान्य् उत्कृष्टानि
“Parardhyāni” means most excellent.
वरीयांसि तत्-प्रियाणि द्युमन्ति दीप्तिमन्ति च
“Varīyāṃsi” means superior and dear to him.
पानं पेयम्
“Dyumanti” means radiant.
अमृतं स्वादु
“Pānam” means a drink.
आसवं मादकम्
“Amṛtam” is sweet; “āsavam” is intoxicating.
entries.literal_english: Then, by bathing and by oils suitable for bathing, and the like. “Parardhyāni” means most excellent. “Varīyāṃsi” means superior and dear to him. “Dyumanti” means radiant. “Pānam” means a drink. “Amṛtam” is sweet; “āsavam” is intoxicating.

entries.sanskrit: आदर्शे स्वम् आत्मानं ददर्शेति शेषः । आत्मानं विशिनष्टि चतुर्भिः । कृतं स्वस्त्य्-अयनं मङ्गलं यस्य । पुंस्त्वम् आत्म-शब्द-सामानाधिकरण्यात् ॥३०॥
word_for_word: आदर्शे स्वम् आत्मानं ददर्शेति शेषः
The words “she saw herself in the mirror” are understood.
आत्मानं विशिनष्टि चतुर्भिः
He describes her in four verses.
कृतं स्वस्त्य्-अयनं मङ्गलं यस्य
“Kṛta-svāsty-ayanam” means that auspicious rites had been performed for her.
पुंस्त्वम् आत्म-शब्द-सामानाधिकरण्यात्
The masculine form is used because “ātman” is grammatically masculine.
entries.literal_english: The words “she saw herself in the mirror” are understood. He describes her in four verses. “Kṛta-svāsty-ayanam” means that auspicious rites had been performed for her. The masculine form is used because “ātman” is grammatically masculine.

entries.sanskrit: विरजम् इत्य् अस्य प्रपञ्चः । स्नातम् उद्वर्त्य क्षालितम् । कृतं शिरः-स्नानम् अभ्यङ्गो येन । भूषितत्वम् एवह । निष्कं पदकं ग्रीवायां यस्य ॥३१॥
word_for_word: विरजम् इत्य् अस्य प्रपञ्चः
This elaborates “virajam.”
स्नातम् उद्वर्त्य क्षालितम्
“Snātam” means bathed, scrubbed, and washed.
कृतं शिरः-स्नानम् अभ्यङ्गो येन
Her body was anointed, and her head was bathed.
भूषितत्वम् एवह
“Bhūṣitatvam” means adorned.
निष्कं पदकं ग्रीवायां यस्य
She wore a necklace-pendant at her neck.
entries.literal_english: This elaborates “virajam.” “Snātam” means bathed, scrubbed, and washed. Her body was anointed, and her head was bathed. “Bhūṣitatvam” means adorned. She wore a necklace-pendant at her neck.

transliteration: virajam ity asya prapañcaḥ | snātam udvartya kṣālitam | kṛtaṃ śiraḥ-snānam abhyaṅgo yena | bhūṣitatvam evaha | niṣkaṃ padakaṃ grīvāyāṃ yasya ||31||

entries.sanskrit: बहूनि रत्नानि यस्यां तया । रुचकेन मङ्गल-द्रव्येण कुङ्कुमादिना । तद् उक्तं विश्व-प्रकाशे---रुचकं मङ्गल-द्रव्ये ग्रीवा-भरण-दन्तयोः इति ।
word_for_word: बहूनि रत्नानि यस्यां तया
She wore an ornament containing many jewels.
रुचकेन मङ्गल-द्रव्येण कुङ्कुमादिना
“Rucaka” is an auspicious substance such as kuṅkuma.
तद् उक्तं विश्व-प्रकाशे---रुचकं मङ्गल-द्रव्ये ग्रीवा-भरण-दन्तयोः इति
As the lexicon Viśva-prakāśa says: “rucaka” denotes an auspicious substance, a neck ornament, or a tooth.
entries.literal_english: She wore an ornament containing many jewels. “Rucaka” is an auspicious substance such as kuṅkuma. As the lexicon Viśva-prakāśa says: “rucaka” denotes an auspicious substance, a neck ornament, or a tooth.

entries.sanskrit: सुदता सुभ्रुवा चक्षुषेति च जाताव् एक-वचनानि । एतैर् लसच् छोभमानं मुखं यस्य । कथं-भूतेन चक्षुषा ? श्लक्ष्णो मनो-हरः स्निग्धोऽपाङ्गो नेत्र-प्रान्तो यस्य । पद्म-कोशेन स्पर्धत इति पद्म-कोश-स्पृत्, तेन ॥३३॥
word_for_word: सुदता सुभ्रुवा चक्षुषेति च जाताव् एक-वचनानि
“Having beautiful teeth,” “beautiful brows,” and “eyes” are singular forms used collectively.
एतैर् लसच् छोभमानं मुखं यस्य
Her face shone and was lovely because of these features.
कथं-भूतेन चक्षुषा ? श्लक्ष्णो मनो-हरः स्निग्धोऽपाङ्गो नेत्र-प्रान्तो यस्य
What sort of eyes? Their outer corners were gentle, charming, and lustrous.
पद्म-कोशेन स्पर्धत इति पद्म-कोश-स्पृत्, तेन
They rivaled the lotus bud.
entries.literal_english: “Having beautiful teeth,” “beautiful brows,” and “eyes” are singular forms used collectively. Her face shone and was lovely because of these features. What sort of eyes? Their outer corners were gentle, charming, and lustrous. They rivaled the lotus bud.

entries.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा च यदा पतिं सस्मार तदा यत्र असौ तत्र एव स्वयम् अप्य् आस्ते ॥३४॥
word_for_word: दृष्ट्वा च यदा पतिं सस्मार तदा यत्र असौ तत्र एव स्वयम् अप्य् आस्ते
When she saw her husband and remembered him, she herself remained there, in that very place.
entries.literal_english: When she saw her husband and remembered him, she herself remained there, in that very place.

entries.sanskrit: आत्मानं निशाम्य दृष्ट्वा । तां च तस्य योग-गतिं योग-प्रभावं दृष्ट्वा । संशयं किम् इदम् इति विस्मयम् ॥३५॥
word_for_word: आत्मानं निशाम्य दृष्ट्वा
“Seeing herself” means beholding herself.
तां च तस्य योग-गतिं योग-प्रभावं दृष्ट्वा
She also saw his yogic power.
संशयं किम् इदम् इति विस्मयम्
She wondered, “What is this?”
entries.literal_english: “Seeing herself” means beholding herself. She also saw his yogic power. She wondered, “What is this?”

transliteration: ātmānaṃ niśāmya dṛṣṭvā | tāṃ ca tasya yoga-gatiṃ yoga-prabhāvaṃ dṛṣṭvā | saṃśayaṃ kim idam iti vismayam ||35||

entries.sanskrit: स मुनिर् विवाहात् प्राग् यद् आत्मनो रूपं, तद् एव पुनर् बिभ्रतीम् । संवीतौ प्रावृतौ रुचिरौ स्तनौ यस्याः । पाठान्तरे तु रूप-विशेषम् ॥३६॥
word_for_word: स मुनिर् विवाहात् प्राग् यद् आत्मनो रूपं, तद् एव पुनर् बिभ्रतीम्
The sage now bore the very form he had possessed before marriage.
संवीतौ प्रावृतौ रुचिरौ स्तनौ यस्याः
Her beautiful breasts were covered with fine garments.
पाठान्तरे तु रूप-विशेषम्
Another reading gives a different form.
entries.literal_english: The sage now bore the very form he had possessed before marriage. Her beautiful breasts were covered with fine garments. Another reading gives a different form.

entries.sanskrit: शोभने वाससी यस्याः । जातो भावः प्रेम यस्य । हे अमित्र-हन् ! जित-काम ! ॥३७॥
word_for_word: शोभने वाससी यस्याः
She wore beautiful garments.
जातो भावः प्रेम यस्य
Love had arisen in her.
हे अमित्र-हन् ! जित-काम !
“O slayer of enemies! O conqueror of desire!”
entries.literal_english: She wore beautiful garments. Love had arisen in her. “O slayer of enemies! O conqueror of desire!”

transliteration: śobhane vāsasī yasyāḥ | jāto bhāvaḥ prema yasya | he amitra-han ! jita-kāma ! ||37||

entries.sanskrit: तस्मिन् विमाने मुनिर् बभ्राजे । न लुप्तो महिमा स्वातन्त्र्यं यस्य । उपचीर्णं शुश्रूषितं वपुर् यस्य । विकसित-कुमुद्-गणवान् अपीव्योऽतिसुन्दरः । पूर्ण-चन्द्र इव मुनिः, नभ इव विमानम्, तारा इव ताः स्त्रियः, कुमुदानीव तासां नेत्राणीति ज्ञेयम् ॥३८॥
word_for_word: तस्मिन् विमाने मुनिर् बभ्राजे
The sage shone in that airplane.
न लुप्तो महिमा स्वातन्त्र्यं यस्य
His majesty and independence had not diminished.
उपचीर्णं शुश्रूषितं वपुर् यस्य
His body had been well attended.
विकसित-कुमुद्-गणवान् अपीव्योऽतिसुन्दरः
He was exceedingly beautiful, like the full moon among blooming water-lilies.
पूर्ण-चन्द्र इव मुनिः, नभ इव विमानम्, तारा इव ताः स्त्रियः, कुमुदानीव तासां नेत्राणीति ज्ञेयम्
The airplane was like the sky, the women like stars, and their eyes like lilies.
entries.literal_english: The sage shone in that airplane. His majesty and independence had not diminished. His body had been well attended. He was exceedingly beautiful, like the full moon among blooming water-lilies. The airplane was like the sky, the women like stars, and their eyes like lilies.

entries.sanskrit: तेन विमानेन । अष्ट-लोक-पालानां विहारो यस्मिन् कुलाचलेन्द्रे मेरौ तस्य द्रोणीषु दरीषु । अनङ्गस्य सखा यो मारुतः शीत-सुगन्धम् अन्दानिलस् तेन सौभगं सौन्दर्यं यासु । सिद्धैर् नुतः स्तुतः सन् । द्युधुनिर् गङ्गा तस्याः पातेन शिवः स्वनो यासु तासु रेमे । ललना-वरूथी स्त्री-रत्न-समूहवान् ॥३९॥
word_for_word: तेन विमानेन
By that airplane he travelled.
अष्ट-लोक-पालानां विहारो यस्मिन् कुलाचलेन्द्रे मेरौ तस्य द्रोणीषु दरीषु
In the ravines of Meru, the king of mountains, where the eight guardians of the worlds sport,
अनङ्गस्य सखा यो मारुतः शीत-सुगन्धम् अन्दानिलस् तेन सौभगं सौन्दर्यं यासु
breezes—cool, fragrant, and friends of Kāma—made them beautiful.
सिद्धैर् नुतः स्तुतः सन्
Praised by the Siddhas,
द्युधुनिर् गङ्गा तस्याः पातेन शिवः स्वनो यासु तासु रेमे
he enjoyed himself in those caves where the falling stream of the heavenly Gaṅgā made a sound.
ललना-वरूथी स्त्री-रत्न-समूहवान्
He was surrounded by a company of the finest women.
entries.literal_english: By that airplane he travelled. In the ravines of Meru, the king of mountains, where the eight guardians of the worlds sport, breezes—cool, fragrant, and friends of Kāma—made them beautiful. Praised by the Siddhas, he enjoyed himself in those caves where the falling stream of the heavenly Gaṅgā made a sound. He was surrounded by a company of the finest women.

transliteration: tena vimānena | aṣṭa-loka-pālānāṃ vihāro yasmin kulācalendre merau tasya droṇīṣu darīṣu | anaṅgasya sakhā yo mārutaḥ śīta-sugandham andānilas tena saubhagaṃ saundaryaṃ yāsu | siddhair nutaḥ stutaḥ san | dyudhunir gaṅgā tasyāḥ pātena śivaḥ svano yāsu tāsu reme | lalanā-varūthī strī-ratna-samūhavān ||39||

entries.sanskrit: वैश्रम्भकादिषु देवोद्यानेषु । मानसे च सरसि । रतः सन् ॥४०॥
word_for_word: वैश्रम्भकादिषु देवोद्यानेषु
In the celestial gardens, such as Vaiśrambhaka,
मानसे च सरसि
and at Lake Mānasa,
रतः सन्
he enjoyed himself.
entries.literal_english: In the celestial gardens, such as Vaiśrambhaka, and at Lake Mānasa, he enjoyed himself.

“Those of exalted minds” means the steadfast sages.
व्यसनं संसारस् तस्यात्ययो यस्मात्
From him comes the end of the distress of worldly existence.
entries.literal_english: “Those of exalted minds” means the steadfast sages. From him comes the end of the distress of worldly existence.

entries.sanskrit: प्रेक्षयित्वा दर्शयित्वा । गोलं मण्डलम् । स्व-संस्थया द्वीप-वर्षादि-रचनया यावांस् तावन्तम् । बहून्य् आश्चर्याणि यस्मिंस् तम् ॥४३॥
word_for_word: प्रेक्षयित्वा दर्शयित्वा
“Having shown” means having made visible.
गोलं मण्डलम्
“Gola” means a sphere or globe.
स्व-संस्थया द्वीप-वर्षादि-रचनया यावांस् तावन्तम्
By its own arrangement of islands, lands, and regions, it had a corresponding extent.
बहून्य् आश्चर्याणि यस्मिंस् तम्
It contained many wonders.
entries.literal_english: “Having shown” means having made visible. “Gola” means a sphere or globe. By its own arrangement of islands, lands, and regions, it had a corresponding extent. It contained many wonders.

entries.literal_english: “Śaradaḥ” means years. They passed almost imperceptibly.

entries.sanskrit: आत्मना स्व-देहार्ध-रूपेणाति-प्रीत्या भावयन् । तथा सति सद्-अपत्यं भवेद् इति। नोधा नवधा । सर्व-सङ्कल्प-विद् इति तस्या बह्व्-अपत्य-सङ्कल्पं जानन्न् इत्य् अर्थः । विभुस् तथा कर्तुं समर्थश् च । आत्म-विद् इति च तस्याम् अनासक्तत्वात् स्त्रियो जाता इति भावः । पुमान् पुंसोऽधिके शुक्रे स्त्री भवत्य् अधिके स्त्रियाः इति स्मृतेः ॥४७॥
word_for_word: आत्मना स्व-देहार्ध-रूपेणाति-प्रीत्या भावयन्
He lovingly contemplated her, becoming the form of half her body.
तथा सति सद्-अपत्यं भवेद् इति
In that way, good offspring would be born.
नोधा नवधा
“Navadhā” means ninefold.
सर्व-सङ्कल्प-विद् इति तस्या बह्व्-अपत्य-सङ्कल्पं जानन्न् इत्य् अर्थः
“Knower of every resolve” means that he knew her desire for many children.
विभुस् तथा कर्तुं समर्थश् च
The all-powerful Lord was able to act accordingly.
आत्म-विद् इति च तस्याम् अनासक्तत्वात् स्त्रियो जाता इति भावः
“Knower of the self” indicates his lack of attachment to her.
पुमान् पुंसोऽधिके शुक्रे स्त्री भवत्य् अधिके स्त्रियाः इति स्मृतेः
Tradition says: when the man’s semen predominates a male is born; when the woman’s predominates, a female.
entries.literal_english: He lovingly contemplated her, becoming the form of half her body. In that way, good offspring would be born. “Navadhā” means ninefold. “Knower of every resolve” means that he knew her desire for many children. The all-powerful Lord was able to act accordingly. “Knower of the self” indicates his lack of attachment to her. Tradition says: when the man’s semen predominates a male is born; when the woman’s predominates, a female.

transliteration: ātmanā sva-dehārdha-rūpeṇāti-prītyā bhāvayan | tathā sati sad-apatyaṃ bhaved iti| nodhā navadhā | sarva-saṅkalpa-vid iti tasyā bahv-apatya-saṅkalpaṃ jānann ity arthaḥ | vibhus tathā kartuṃ samarthaś ca | ātma-vid iti ca tasyām anāsaktatvāt striyo jātā iti bhāvaḥ | pumān puṃso’dhike śukre strī bhavaty adhike striyāḥ iti smṛteḥ ||47||

entries.sanskrit: अतोऽनन्तरम् एव । सद्य एकस्मिन्न् एवाहनि । चारूणि सर्वाण्य् अङ्गानि यासाम् ॥४८॥
word_for_word: अतोऽनन्तरम् एव
Immediately thereafter.
सद्य एकस्मिन्न् एवाहनि
At once, on a single day.
चारूणि सर्वाण्य् अङ्गानि यासाम्
They were all beautiful in every limb.
entries.literal_english: Immediately thereafter. At once, on a single day. They were all beautiful in every limb.

entries.sanskrit: प्रवृजिष्यन्तम् आलक्ष्य वितर्क्य स्मयमाना बहिः, अन्तस् तु विक्लवेन व्याकुलेन विदूयता सन्तप्यमानेन हृदा उवाचेत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः ॥४९॥
word_for_word: प्रवृजिष्यन्तम् आलक्ष्य वितर्क्य स्मयमाना बहिः, अन्तस् तु विक्लवेन व्याकुलेन विदूयता सन्तप्यमानेन हृदा उवाचेत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः
Seeing and conjecturing that he was about to depart, she smiled outwardly; inwardly, however, her heart was agitated, distressed, and burning, and she spoke [as described next].
entries.literal_english: Seeing and conjecturing that he was about to depart, she smiled outwardly; inwardly, however, her heart was agitated, distressed, and burning, and she spoke [as described next].

entries.sanskrit: नखा एव मणयस् तैः श्रीः शोभा यस्य तेन पदा भुवं लिखन्तीति दुरन्त-चिन्ता-लक्षणाम् ॥५०॥
word_for_word: नखा एव मणयस् तैः श्रीः शोभा यस्य तेन पदा भुवं लिखन्तीति दुरन्त-चिन्ता-लक्षणाम्
The splendour of her feet, whose nails were jewels, as she traced the ground with them, showed the mark of her unending anxiety.
entries.literal_english: The splendour of her feet, whose nails were jewels, as she traced the ground with them, showed the mark of her unending anxiety.

entries.sanskrit: उपोवाह संपादितवान् । अभयम् इति भाविनो दैन्यात् संसाराच् च यद् भयं तन् निवर्तयेत्य् अर्थः ॥५१॥
word_for_word: उपोवाह संपादितवान्
“Upovāha” means “brought about” or “provided.”
अभयम् इति भाविनो दैन्यात् संसाराच् च यद् भयं तन् निवर्तयेत्य् अर्थः
“Fearlessness” means: remove the future fear of destitution and the fear of worldly existence.
entries.literal_english: “Upovāha” means “brought about” or “provided.” “Fearlessness” means: remove the future fear of destitution and the fear of worldly existence.

transliteration: upovāha saṃpāditavān | abhayam iti bhāvino dainyāt saṃsārāc ca yad bhayaṃ tan nivartayety arthaḥ ||51||

entries.sanskrit: तत्र दैन्यं निवेदयति । तुभ्यं तव दुहितृभिः स्वयम् एवात्मनः समा योग्याः पतयो विमृग्या इति दैन्यं प्राप्तम् । संसार-भयम् उररी-कृत्याह---कश्चिद् इति । विशोकाय ज्ञानोपदेशाय । स्त्रीभिर् ऋणान् अपाकरणात् कञ्चित् कालं त्वद्-अवस्थानेन ब्रह्म-वित् पुत्रः कश्चित् किं स्याद् इत्य् अर्थः ॥५२॥
word_for_word: तत्र दैन्यं निवेदयति
Here she states her distress.
तुभ्यं तव दुहितृभिः स्वयम् एवात्मनः समा योग्याः पतयो विमृग्या इति दैन्यं प्राप्तम्
She felt humbled because suitable husbands equal to your daughters must be sought by you yourself.
संसार-भयम् उररी-कृत्याह---कश्चिद् इति
Accepting the fear of worldly existence, she says, “someone…”
विशोकाय ज्ञानोपदेशाय
“For freedom from sorrow” means for instruction in knowledge.
स्त्रीभिर् ऋणान् अपाकरणात् कञ्चित् कालं त्वद्-अवस्थानेन ब्रह्म-वित् पुत्रः कश्चित् किं स्याद् इत्य् अर्थः
Since offspring discharge one’s debts, might there be some son, a knower of Brahman, who would remain with you for a time?
entries.literal_english: Here she states her distress. She felt humbled because suitable husbands equal to your daughters must be sought by you yourself. Accepting the fear of worldly existence, she says, “someone…” “For freedom from sorrow” means for instruction in knowledge. Since offspring discharge one’s debts, might there be some son, a knower of Brahman, who would remain with you for a time?

entries.sanskrit: विषयान् भुङ्क्ष्व किं ब्रह्म-विद्ययेति चेत् तत्राह---एतावतालं पूर्यताम् । परित्यक्तः पर आत्मा यया तस्या मम ॥५३॥
word_for_word: विषयान् भुङ्क्ष्व किं ब्रह्म-विद्ययेति चेत् तत्राह---एतावतालं पूर्यताम्
If you ask, “Why enjoy sense objects? What need is there for knowledge of Brahman?” she answers: “That much is enough; let it be fulfilled.”
परित्यक्तः पर आत्मा यया तस्या मम
“I am one by whom the Supreme Self has been abandoned.”
entries.literal_english: If you ask, “Why enjoy sense objects? What need is there for knowledge of Brahman?” she answers: “That much is enough; let it be fulfilled.” “I am one by whom the Supreme Self has been abandoned.”

transliteration: viṣayān bhuṅkṣva kiṃ brahma-vidyayeti cet tatrāha---etāvatālaṃ pūryatām | parityaktaḥ para ātmā yayā tasyā mama ||53||

entries.sanskrit: स्व-कृतम् अनुशोचन्त्य् आह---इन्द्रियार्थेष्व् इति चतुर्भिः । मे मया । परं भावं त्वं ब्रह्म-विद् इति ॥५४॥
word_for_word: स्व-कृतम् अनुशोचन्त्य् आह---इन्द्रियार्थेष्व् इति चतुर्भिः
She laments what she herself has done, in four verses beginning “indriyārtheṣu.”
मे मया
“Me” means “by me.”
परं भावं त्वं ब्रह्म-विद् इति
“Your supreme nature” means: you, the knower of Brahman.
entries.literal_english: She laments what she herself has done, in four verses beginning “indriyārtheṣu.” “Me” means “by me.” “Your supreme nature” means: you, the knower of Brahman.

transliteration: sva-kṛtam anuśocanty āha---indriyārtheṣv iti caturbhiḥ | me mayā | paraṃ bhāvaṃ tvaṃ brahma-vid iti ||54||

entries.sanskrit: प्रसङ्गः कथम् अभयायास्तु तत्राह---सङ्ग इति । अधियाज्ञानेन ॥५५॥
word_for_word: प्रसङ्गः कथम् अभयायास्तु तत्राह---सङ्ग इति
One may ask, “How can attachment lead to fearlessness?”
अधियाज्ञानेन
He answers: through knowledge of the Lord of sacrifice.
entries.literal_english: One may ask, “How can attachment lead to fearlessness?” He answers: through knowledge of the Lord of sacrifice.

entries.sanskrit: स्वभावतः प्रवृत्तं यस्य कर्म धर्मार्थं न कल्पते धर्माभिमुखं न भवेत्, तत्रापि निष्काम-धर्म-द्वारा विरागाय न कल्पते । तद्-द्वारा च तीर्थ-पदस्य हरेः सेवार्थं न पर्यवस्येद् इत्य् अर्थः ॥५६॥
word_for_word: स्वभावतः प्रवृत्तं यस्य कर्म धर्मार्थं न कल्पते धर्माभिमुखं न भवेत्, तत्रापि निष्काम-धर्म-द्वारा विरागाय न कल्पते
For one whose action proceeds merely from material nature, it is not directed toward dharma.
तद्-द्वारा च तीर्थ-पदस्य हरेः सेवार्थं न पर्यवस्येद् इत्य् अर्थः
Nor does it lead through desireless dharma to detachment, and then to service of Hari, the Lord of the sacred place.
entries.literal_english: For one whose action proceeds merely from material nature, it is not directed toward dharma. Nor does it lead through desireless dharma to detachment, and then to service of Hari, the Lord of the sacred place.
